That lets internal release-consistency checks masquerade as coverage of origin-of-life, social institutions, theory change, recursion, K-collapse, and minimality phenomena.
findings.required_repair: Demote these rows to ILLUSTRATIVE_INTERNAL_MODEL_NOT_PHENOMENON_COVERAGE or exclude them from coverage totals until each has an independent scientific theorem or empirical/domain model with its own falsifier and support boundary.
